inline: ulimit -s unlimited; ulimit -n "$(ulimit -Hn)"; PATH="$(nix --extra-experimental-features 'nix-command flakes' build --no-link --print-out-paths nixpkgs#git)/bin:$PATH"; ACCESS_TOKENS_OPT=""; [ -n "$GITHUB_TOKEN" ] && ACCESS_TOKENS_OPT="--option access-tokens github.com=$GITHUB_TOKEN"; if [ -n "$ATTIC_URL" ]; then echo "Using binary cache (sui): $ATTIC_URL"; nixos-rebuild boot --flake $FLAKE_REF $ACCESS_TOKENS_OPT --option extra-substituters "$ATTIC_URL" --option require-sigs false $NIX_BUILD_OPTS; else nixos-rebuild boot --flake $FLAKE_REF $ACCESS_TOKENS_OPT $NIX_BUILD_OPTS; fi

# Substrate base hardening profile.
#
# Safe baseline — every AMI that claims to be pleme-io-produced should
# compose at least this profile. Nothing here is workload-specific.
#
# Consumed by `kindling harden --profile base.yaml`. Stack with
# `hardened.yaml` and `ami-snapshot.yaml` for a full production bake.

name: base
description: |
  Minimal, non-destructive baseline applied to every pleme-io AMI.
  Removes docs + locales, applies CIS-aligned sysctl + modprobe
  drop-ins, hardens sshd.

minimize:
  - strip-docs
  - strip-locales

kernel:
  - sysctl-baseline
  - blacklist-modules

network:
  - sshd-strict

audit:
  - auditd-baseline

on_failure: warn

# Substrate hardened profile.
#
# Adds the more aggressive primitives on top of `base.yaml` — tmpfs
# for sensitive dirs, kernel lockdown, firewall default-deny,
# moduli regen, build-tool strip. Still safe for any server role.
# Pair with `ami-snapshot.yaml` for the final-cleanup layer.

name: hardened
description: |
  Adds firewall, kernel lockdown, tmpfs mounts, default-user removal,
  and stripped build tooling on top of the base profile.

minimize:
  - strip-debug
  - strip-build-tools
  - minimize-closure

fs:
  - tmpfs-sensitive-dirs
  - remount-readonly

kernel:
  - kernel-lockdown

network:
  - firewall-deny-all
  - ssh-moduli-regen

audit:
  - remove-default-users

params:
  firewall_allow_in:
    - 22
  keep_locales:
    - en_US.UTF-8
    - C

on_failure: abort

# Substrate AMI-snapshot profile — runs LAST.
#
# This is the "burn everything, we're about to snapshot" layer. It
# wipes build history, ssh keys, cloud-init state, and zero-fills free
# space so the resulting EBS snapshot compresses tight. Never compose
# this in a long-lived-machine context — only in AMI build pipelines.

name: ami-snapshot
description: |
  Final-pass scrub for AMIs. Wipes logs, history, cloud-init state,
  host ssh keys, and zero-fills free space. Must run after every
  other profile in the stack.

scrub:
  - scrub-logs
  - scrub-cloud-init
  - scrub-shell-history
  - scrub-ssh-keys
  - scrub-temp-dirs
  - zero-fill

on_failure: warn

HARDEN_TOKEN_OPT=""; [ -n "$GITHUB_TOKEN" ] && HARDEN_TOKEN_OPT="--option access-tokens github.com=$GITHUB_TOKEN"; nix --extra-experimental-features 'nix-command flakes' run github:pleme-io/kindling --accept-flake-config $HARDEN_TOKEN_OPT -- harden --profile /tmp/kindling-harden/base.yaml --profile /tmp/kindling-harden/hardened.yaml --profile /tmp/kindling-harden/ami-snapshot.yaml --format text
